runner.method: Finite input enumeration executing mechanically extracted original TypeScript function bodies with native Node type stripping. Dependency boundaries use explicit mocks. Mutants edit actual extracted source guard conditions.
runner.scope: Function-level synchronous observations and awaited dependency results; not concurrent schedules, real process termination, kernel locks, SQL, IPC or end-to-end deployment.

cards.method: Execute actual repository class through injected in-memory repository, card and transport ports; not PostgreSQL or real node integration.

findings.rationale: reject() rereads the current card and uses its fresh version; it checks only running/queued, not dispatch identity, admittedCardVersion or intervening status changes. This harness cannot establish the production reachability or intended semantics of every reassignment path.

cards.scope: SQL claim atomicity and snapshot semantics are port assumptions. Covers controller branch logic, not worker execution registration, DB isolation, authorization routes, leases or end-to-end exactly-once execution.

delivery.method: Breadth-first finite-state exploration using original production functions, not a hand-transcribed implementation
assumptions: No enqueue after a message has been removed for consumption; downstream deduplication and receipts are outside this check.
Repeated enqueue carries exactly the same immutable message and identity.
Each synchronous function call is one atomic step; no database, network, process crash, or asynchronous engine call is modeled.
